topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Owner's direct oversight: the owner is the only decision-maker; POL-01 states the security commitments to customers, and section 12 requires every public security claim to be true and substantiated
Not applicable: a sole proprietorship has no board of directors. Oversight is the owner's own annual review (POL-01 4.5), with testing by someone outside the company at least every second year
Owner's direct oversight: the owner holds every role, designated in writing in POL-01 4.2; the freelance developer's role is limited by POL-01 7.3
Owner relies on self-study; the freelance developer has had no security training
gap: No security training for either person with privileged access
remediation: Small-business security course for the owner; phishing and credential-handling training for the freelancer before access (POL-01 9.5)

control_description: Owner's direct oversight for the owner's own work. The freelance developer, who holds privileged access, works under an agreement with a confidentiality clause and no security terms
gap: Contractor not bound to security duties
remediation: Signed security addendum (POL-01 5.1; POAM-002)

control_description: Portal, console, registrar, and dashboard record sign-ins and actions, but nobody reviews them; the dashboard keeps its log 30 days only
gap: Logs not reviewed or kept long enough to answer a customer after an incident
remediation: Weekly review and monthly export kept 12 months (POAM-007)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: The only other person with access is the freelance developer. POL-01 applies to the developer, but it has not been sent, explained, or acknowledged
gap: Rules not communicated to the contractor
remediation: Freelancer signs the addendum and acknowledges POL-01 sections 5 and 7 to 10

control_description: Customers see the Terms of Service and the website. The terms have no incident notice clause, there is no customer security contact list, and four website claims and two questionnaire answers were not true (P03 G-037 to G-042)
gap: Commitments to customers are inaccurate and incident communication is undefined
remediation: Correct the claims and answers (2026-10-15); collect a security contact for every customer (2026-10-31); add patching, backup, and incident notice clauses to the Terms (2026-12-31)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in POL-01 and the BIA (P05): keep customer sites and mail available, protect customer data, meet the 10-day notice duty
First risk assessment completed 2026-08-21 with SP 800-30 Rev. 1 (15 risks)

Fraud through the company's own tools is partly covered: skimmers on stores (R-001) and domain or account hijacking for ransom (R-002). Fake payment-change requests to the owner and fraudulent sign-ups using stolen cards in the portal are not assessed
gap: Billing and sign-up fraud not assessed
remediation: Add fraud scenarios at the August 2027 risk review; turn on the processor's fraud screening for portal sign-ups

control_description: Change triggers for a new risk review are set in POL-01 4.3. The AI triage feature was turned on in May 2026 with no review, which is the kind of change the rule now covers
gap: No change has yet been assessed under the rule
remediation: Apply the rule to the independent backup service and the business password manager rollout (first significant changes)

control_description: Annual self-assessment (P07) with tests run with the contract security consultant; limited independence
gap: Self-review only
remediation: Outside testing at least every second year (POL-01 4.5)

control_description: Owner's direct oversight: the owner finds and fixes deficiencies and tracks them in the POA&M

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the risk assessment (P02 control set of 24 controls)
Technology controls partly in place: MFA on the reseller console, registrar, email, and password manager; not on the portal administrator login or the freelancer's dashboard account
gap: MFA gaps on the two tools that reach every customer
remediation: POAM-001

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 adopted 2026-09-28; the P08 runbook is the main procedure

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Portal administrator login (holds API credentials for every hosting account and domain) uses a password only; the freelancer's dashboard administrator account has no MFA
gap: Very High POA&M item
remediation: POAM-001 (MFA by 2026-10-15; security keys by 2027-03-31)

control_description: Contractor accounts are created on request with no written approval; a former contractor's dashboard account stayed active nine months
gap: No approval or removal step
remediation: Written approval and same-day removal (POL-01 7.4; POAM-002)

control_description: The freelancer holds the administrator role over all 120 connected sites, including package upload and bulk actions; no account review
gap: Contractor access far beyond the task
remediation: Limited role on assigned sites; monthly review (POAM-003; POAM-002)

control_description: Inherited: customer data is processed only in the upstream provider's U.S. data centers; cage access by the provider was tested in its SOC 2 report and facility controls are carved out to colocation providers that the upstream provider reviews (vendor-soc2-review.csv). The home office holds no servers
18 closed customers' hosting accounts are suspended but not terminated, some since 2024, so their data is still stored; the 2025 laptop was reset before trade-in but no disposal record is kept
gap: Data of former customers kept; disposal not recorded
remediation: Terminate closed accounts 30 days after export; disposal record (POL-01 8.6 and 8.7)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Inherited network and server firewalls, denial-of-service filtering, and server-level malware scanning from the upstream provider. Hosting-only sites face the internet with known-vulnerable plugins
evidence: Upstream SOC 2 report; P07 SI-2 results
gap: 64 hosting-only sites ran a vulnerable plugin
remediation: Monthly notices and free automatic security updates (POAM-008)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Customer site and SFTP passwords are sent by plain email and kept in a spreadsheet; customer data was pasted into a consumer AI chat assistant
gap: Credentials and customer data moved through unprotected channels
remediation: Password manager vault and rotation (POAM-004); no customer data in unapproved AI tools (POL-01 9.4)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Daily malware scans on all 270 sites and server-level scanning, but AI triage auto-dismisses findings with no review, and any dashboard account can install any plugin package on many sites
gap: Detection filtered by AI; no limit on who can push code
remediation: Protected categories never auto-dismissed (POAM-009); only the owner pushes to more than one site (POAM-003)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Daily vulnerability scans on all sites; care-plan sites patched weekly; hosting-only sites not patched; no alert on changed dashboard settings
gap: Findings on hosting-only sites go nowhere
remediation: POAM-008

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No review of control plane sign-ins or the dashboard activity log; AI-dismissed findings never reviewed
gap: No monitoring of the tools that reach every customer
remediation: Weekly review and sign-in alerts (POAM-007); weekly review of dismissed findings (POAM-009)

control_description: Breach determination step defined in POL-01 10.3 and P08; the 2026-08-05 web shell determination was not written down
gap: Determinations not documented; runbook untested
remediation: Walkthrough with the consultant (POAM-010)

control_description: P08 runbook adopted 2026-09-28; no breach counsel, no cyber insurance, no customer security contacts yet
gap: Runbook untested; outside help not lined up
remediation: Name breach counsel and collect contacts (2026-10-31); walkthrough (POAM-010)

control_description: Upstream nightly backups (7 days) restored a site correctly in the 2026-08-19 test; 235 sites have no other copy
gap: No independent backup for most sites
remediation: Independent 30-day backups and quarterly restore tests (POAM-005)

control_description: The company develops no software, but it changes 120 customer sites every week through bulk plugin, theme, and core updates. Updates go to all sites at once with no test site; 2 sites broke in July 2026
evidence: P07 SI-2 results; dashboard update history
gap: No test before bulk changes
remediation: One test site before every bulk update; 72-hour rule for critical updates (POAM-008)

control_description: Owner is a single point of failure; every second factor on one phone; no cyber insurance
gap: No backup operator or emergency access
remediation: Emergency access envelope and backup-operator arrangement (P01 R-009); insurance decision

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Upstream provider's SOC 2 report reviewed 2026-09-09 (Part B). No vendor list; dashboard and security service vendors' data locations and data-use terms unverified; freelancer has no security terms
gap: Oversight covers only the upstream provider
remediation: Vendor list and written confirmations (POAM-006); freelancer addendum (POL-01 5.1)
